facts.fact: The National Communication Authority attributed the rise in internet users from 1.3 million in 2024 to 1.9 million in 2025 partly to 'the implementation of the Digital Government Strategy', a claim of implementation measured against no target of the strategy; the article gives no date for the strategy, so as_of is the article date (3 July 2025).

systems.tiers: named by the NCA as implemented; no description of scope, adoption, period or text
described as launched; no date given

note: Digital Government Strategy is named without any description of its scope, so the reporting fact carries an empty class.
